hints.text: Check which coordinate is the same in both points. A shared coordinate means the segment runs straight across or straight up.
Both points have $y = 4$, so the segment is horizontal. Subtract the $x$-values and take the absolute value: $|5 - (-2)|$.

explanation: Both points have $y = 4$, so they lie on the same horizontal line.
The distance is the absolute value of the difference of the $x$-values: $|5 - (-2)|$.
Subtracting $-2$ is the same as adding $2$, so this is $|5 + 2| = 7$.
The distance between the points is $7$ units.
